3.10 P. M 
Ft Monroe Apl 23. 1864
For Genl Ramsay, Chief of Ord Washn 
---- Please send me three hundred thousand 
cartridges for spencer rifles with all
possible dispatch sig Theodore Edson Captain Ord


5.10 PM  New York Apr 23rd 1864
New York, April 23rd ----
for Colonel Parker Chief
of Police Washn Is
Solomon B Ellithorp in
the Employ of the
secret service Please reply
sig Jno A. Dix Major General


5 PM
7 PM  Culpeper Apl 23. 1864
5 PM for Gen Halleck
Gen Butler dispatch of this date
suggests I think the right 
course to pursue in
notifying the French to dis-
continue shipping their tobacco.
please direct him to adopt
it U. S. Grant Lt Genl.
